source_semantics.reported_current_quarter_revenue: first TSMC quarterly EPS press-release sentence announcing consolidated revenue in NT$ billions
source_semantics.next_quarter_guidance: first explicit next-quarter revenue expected between low/high in same original issuer release, all billion units
source_semantics.USD_guidance_conversion: Multiply USD billions guidance midpoint by same release assumption of NT dollars per 1 US dollar; NT guidance stays NT billions.
source_semantics.formula: converted next-quarter forward revenue midpoint in NT billions / current reported consolidated revenue in NT billions - 1

timing.clock_source: original EDGAR complete-submission header acceptance date, not the submissions API Z timestamp (observed 8/10-hour mismatch)
timing.availability: earliest Stage1 signal date strictly after SEC filing/acceptance calendar date on Qlib native day calendar; trade occurs following session, so no same-day issuer release use
timing.historical_revision_handling: original first matched accession per reporting month retained; later 6-K amendments are not backfilled into original values
timing.matched_source_calendar: D.calendar day 2011-01-03 through 2026-10-09, full days and unknown before first event retained

stop: Any parent/raw hash, original CIK/accession/quarter, actual revenue, guidance currency/range or FX ambiguity stops before Recorder. Require 64 unique events, 26 NT and 38 USD, exact unambiguous numeric extraction, monotonic availability. No source-only result can authorize 0bp account or independent validation.
